to acquire Advanced Technology Distributors’ IT, telecommunications, connectivity, and managed services business for up to $2.7M.
The acquisition will occur in two stages, with IPM acquiring an initial 49% stake followed by the remaining 51%.
The transaction is subject to California Public Utilities Commission approvals for the transfer of AdTech’s telecommunications license and the subsequent change of control.
Total consideration may include cash payments, a seller note, and performance-based earnout payments tied to specified milestones.
Following the final closing, AdTech’s business subsidiary, JVCo, will become a wholly owned subsidiary of IPM.

title: IPM to acquire AdTech’s managed technology business for up to $2.7M
